title: Portuguese Chicken Bake
description: A traditional Portuguese-inspired dish featuring tender chicken and a rich, velvety sauce, all baked to perfection.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the port wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and bring to a simmer.
Place the chicken breasts in the skillet and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped rosemary and serve hot.
